corpus_root_policy: local external input; paths and raw payloads are not retained

definitions.connected_route: modulation source and destination are both populated
definitions.custom_lfo_shape: shape descriptor differs from the canonical init shape, ignoring display name
definitions.duplicate_sensitivity: file_weighted counts every parsed file; exact_deduplicated counts one representative per raw-byte SHA-256
definitions.introduced_parameter_defaults: not established by the pinned atlas; report nonzero observations and leave non-default unsupported
definitions.live_route: connected, not bypassed, and modulation amount is non-zero
definitions.non_default: scalar differs from the pinned atlas default; missing common scalar keys are treated as defaults
definitions.non_init_wavetable: semantic descriptor differs from the canonical init wavetable, with payloads represented only by in-process hashes; this is diagnostic and is not itself a custom-content claim
definitions.operational_envelope_lfo_random: the source appears in at least one live route; always-wired synth behavior is not inferred
definitions.sampler_content: named stock/unresolved classification; sample payloads are never compared or published
definitions.wavetable_content: active wavetable slots are classified by known stock names or left unresolved; names do not prove payload provenance
definitions.zero_amount_route: connected route whose modulation amount is zero or unavailable
